```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| label: fig-home-map
#| fig-cap: "Number of participants by neighborhood in New York City"


scale_labels <- c("0", "1-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31+")

mpxnyc::neighborhood_sf_obj |>
   sf::st_as_sf() |>
  dplyr::left_join(make_tabledata_residence(), by = "neighborhood") |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count_cat = cut(count, c(-1,0,10,20,30,76), scale_labels)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(-count) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = mpxnyc::community_sf_obj, fill = "white", linewidth = 0, color = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = mpxnyc::community_sf_obj, fill = "#009BE8", linewidth = 0, color = NA, alpha = 0.1) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(ggplot2::aes(alpha = count_cat), linewidth = 0, fill = "#009BE8", color = "#C5EFFF") +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = mpxnyc::community_sf_obj, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_discrete("Participant\ncount") +
  theme_mpxnyc_blank(
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "right"
    )


```
